icons.label: Home
icons.meaning: Home or top-level destination. Do not substitute for Back.

review.note: One rounded pentagon: ACUTE_JOIN gable and shoulders, CORNER_TOKEN feet, apex on the top keyline. 16 px door is narrower and sits lower so the outline still reads as a house.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Menu
icons.meaning: Open navigation or a menu.

review.note: Three equal capsule rows. The 12 outline rows sit on pixel rows inside the filled 2 px rows, a registered 0.5 px offset from the canvas centre.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: More
icons.meaning: Additional actions in an overflow menu.

review.note: Three round dots. A ring this small would close, so filled means larger dots, not a different shape.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Search
icons.meaning: Find content. A heavier lens still has an open center.

review.note: Circular lens and capsule handle. The octagon is Outline; Rounded must not use it.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Grid
icons.meaning: Open an application grid or change to grid view.

review.note: Four identical rounded panels with one gutter. Dashboard shares the gutter and changes the panel heights.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Arrow left
icons.meaning: Literal left arrow; application chooses its navigation role.

review.note: An exact reflection of Arrow right, so the 12 outline shaft stays on the same pixel row. Registered 0.5 px offset.
review.usage: The application chooses left/right; artwork does not auto-mirror.

icons.label: Arrow right
icons.meaning: A literal right arrow. Navigation direction must be chosen by the application.

review.note: One continuous round-capped shaft into a round-joined head, at a 45-degree half-angle and a two-thirds-canvas span on all six drawings. The outline 12 shaft sits on a pixel row, a registered 0.5 px offset from its filled partner.
review.usage: The application chooses left/right; artwork does not auto-mirror.

icons.label: Arrow up
icons.meaning: Literal up arrow, not Upload.

review.note: Arrow right turned up, on pixel column 5.5 at 12 outline. Registered 0.5 px offset. Not Upload: it has no baseline.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Arrow down
icons.meaning: Literal down arrow, not Download.

review.note: A reflection of Arrow right, so it shares Arrow up's pixel column instead of the opposite one. Registered 0.5 px offset. Not Download: it has no baseline.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Arrow up right
icons.meaning: Open another destination. Keep a visible action label.

review.note: One diagonal shaft running into a 90-degree round corner. The arms stop short, so the mass stays clear of the top and right keylines.
review.usage: Requires a visible action label at every size: it opens another destination.

icons.label: Chevron left
icons.meaning: Compact left direction. Navigation semantics stay in the component.

review.note: An exact reflection of Chevron right.
review.usage: The application chooses left/right; artwork does not auto-mirror.

icons.label: Chevron right
icons.meaning: Compact right direction. Not an external-link marker.

review.note: One 90-degree round bend, centred on the canvas, with a shorter field than an arrow.
review.usage: The application chooses left/right; artwork does not auto-mirror.

icons.label: Chevron up
icons.meaning: Up direction or collapse, with a label.

review.note: Chevron right turned up.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Chevron down
icons.meaning: Down direction or disclosure, with a label.

review.note: Chevron right reflected to point down.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Plus
icons.meaning: Add or create. Distinct from expand and zoom-in.

review.note: Two crossing capsules. Round terminals are the Rounded tell versus Outline square caps.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Minus
icons.meaning: Decrease or subtract. Not a destructive delete substitute.

review.note: One capsule at Plus's stroke weights. The 12 outline sits on a pixel row, a registered 0.5 px offset.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Check
icons.meaning: Confirm or communicate completion.

review.note: One asymmetric round bend. The long arm rises past the short arm's start.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Close
icons.meaning: Dismiss or close. Do not use as a destructive delete substitute.

review.note: Two crossing capsules on the diagonals, with no cut at the crossing.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Edit
icons.meaning: A pencil for editing content.

review.note: A pencil on one diagonal: round tip, parallel sides, and a soft eraser end split off by one rail, which is a cut in filled.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Copy
icons.meaning: Create a duplicate or copy to clipboard.

review.note: A front sheet over a rear contour. The rear stays a round-capped contour in both styles, so filled never becomes two blocks.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Trash
icons.meaning: Delete. Confirm destructive behavior at the application level.

review.note: A capsule lid with a handle bump, floating over a tapered body at the gap target. Two slots at 24 px only.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Refresh
icons.meaning: Reload the current data. Not Undo or Redo.

review.note: One open cycle ending in one round-joined head. The arc starts later in filled, so the heavier head keeps the gap target from its tail.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Filter
icons.meaning: A funnel that narrows a result set. Not generic adjustment controls.

review.note: One funnel with soft shoulders. The stem is exactly two contours wide, so the outline ring leaves it solid.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Sliders
icons.meaning: Adjust parameters. Not a funnel filter or gear glyph.

review.note: Circular knobs on stadium rails. Two rows at every native size.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Upload
icons.meaning: Transfer into a service.

review.note: Arrow up over a capsule baseline, at the gap target or wider. The 12 outline sits on pixel column 5.5, a registered 0.5 px offset.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Download
icons.meaning: Transfer out to this device.

review.note: Arrow down over the same baseline as Upload. The 12 outline sits on pixel column 5.5, a registered 0.5 px offset.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Save
icons.meaning: A disk metaphor for committing changes. Not Bookmark or Download.

review.note: A disk with a clipped round corner, a shutter slot, and a label window. The label is a rail that meets the frame in outline and a window cut in filled.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: File
icons.meaning: A document. Not a duplicate action.

review.note: Portrait page with CORNER_TOKEN on its three page corners and a turned-down corner: solid in outline, where a counter would be a sub-pixel pocket, and split off by a gap-target slit in filled. Two unequal left-aligned lines at 24 px only.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Folder
icons.meaning: A folder or grouped files.

review.note: A soft tab on a wider body, with a softened junction. Filled stays solid: the tab already names it.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Link
icons.meaning: A link or related resource. Not external navigation by itself.

review.note: Two capsule rings on one 45-degree axis, woven so that each crosses over the other once, at every master and style. The weave separation and the thinner filled 12 px stroke are registered in catalog/exceptions.json. Requires a visible text label at 12 px.
review.usage: Requires a visible text label at 12 px. At 16 and 24 px, use the action name on the enclosing control.

icons.label: Bookmark
icons.meaning: Save a reference for later. Different from saving changed data.

review.note: A ribbon with soft top corners, two round points, and an open V notch.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Star
icons.meaning: Favorite or rating, with context. Distinct from Focus.

review.note: Five-point star with round points and round inner notches. STAR_JOIN is ~0.5× outline (0.65 / 0.85 / 1.0); 1.0×+ join collapses mass. Outer radius is sized so filled 24 mass tracks Outline (~0.27 of canvas) rather than sitting ~30% light.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Calendar
icons.meaning: A date or calendar.

review.note: CORNER_TOKEN body with tabs and a header rail at contour weight. No date marks at 12 or 16 px; a row of three at 24 px.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: User
icons.meaning: A person or profile.

review.note: Circular head over a dome torso: broad shoulder circles and smaller base corners. Outline uses an octagonal head.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Chat
icons.meaning: A message or conversation.

review.note: A rounded bubble with one round tail. A content line appears at 24 px only.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Bell
icons.meaning: Notifications. Do not imply a warning or failure by shape alone.

review.note: A dome running into a rim, with a detached capsule clapper at the gap target. A crown stub at 16 and 24 px.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Warning
icons.meaning: A warning requiring a visible text label in every supported appearance and native size.

review.note: ACUTE_JOIN triangle authored from its corner circles, so the apex stays on the keyline, with capsule stem and circular dot at the gap target. At 12 and 16 px the glyph is centred on a pixel column, a registered 0.5 px offset, so the mark is solid at 1x. Visible-label restriction is concept-level.

icons.label: Info
icons.meaning: Information about content or a status. Distinct from Help and Warning.

review.note: A circular frame with a dot over a capsule stem, on the canvas centre. The stem is 1.5 px at 12 and 16, so it covers two columns evenly and stays symmetric in the frame.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Help
icons.meaning: Assistance or documentation. Distinct from information status.

review.note: A circular frame with a round hook and dot, at the gap target. The 16 px hook has no separate stem, so the gaps fit.
review.usage: Visible label required at 12 px; contextual label recommended at other sizes.

icons.label: Lock
icons.meaning: Restricted access or locked content.

review.note: A round shackle with an open counter on a rounded body. A keyhole at 24 px only.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Shield
icons.meaning: Protection or policy. Pair with the actual status in text.

review.note: Broad shoulders and straight sides tapering to one round point, with no status mark. Pair it with the status in text.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Gear
icons.meaning: A gear settings metaphor. Sliders remains a separate adjustment glyph.

review.note: Teeth grown from one body, with the hub as the only counter. Six teeth at 12 px, eight at 16 and 24 px. Outline has a wider hub; filled has a smaller one.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Terminal
icons.meaning: A command interface. Not an ordinary next arrow.

review.note: A rounded window holding a chevron prompt and a cursor. Marks are positive in outline and cut out in filled.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Branch
icons.meaning: A branching relationship. Use a visible label, especially at 12 px.

review.note: Three circular nodes and round-joined connectors. Outline uses square nodes. The 16 px outline node counters are a registered shortfall against the counter floor.
review.usage: Requires a visible text label at every size and appearance. This rule is separate from the Warning restriction record.

icons.label: Chart
icons.meaning: A bar chart or analytics view.

review.note: Three ascending capsule bars. The 12 outline bars sit on pixel columns inside the filled 2 px bars, a registered 0.5 px offset.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Play
icons.meaning: Play media or start an operation. Do not auto-mirror in RTL.

review.note: A round-joined triangle, shifted right of the canvas centre so its mass balances. Not auto-mirrored.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Pause
icons.meaning: Pause an operation. Do not use for stop.

review.note: Two capsule bars. Heavier in filled, and never hollow, because a slot would be fragile at 12 px.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Focus
icons.meaning: Focus a region. Context is required; not a star or fullscreen symbol.

review.note: Four round corner brackets around a round centre. Filled is a heavier stroke and a larger centre.
review.usage: Visible label required at 12 px; contextual label recommended at other sizes.

icons.label: Activity
icons.meaning: A pulse of activity; existing registry activity motif.

review.note: One round-joined pulse line on a shared baseline, unchanged in filled except for weight.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Align center
icons.meaning: Align selected objects on a horizontal center axis; distinct from text paragraph formatting.

review.note: A vertical axis stopping at two panels centred on it. Both panels share one horizontal centre. At 12 px the axis sits on a pixel column, a registered 0.5 px offset in both styles.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Align left
icons.meaning: Align selected objects to their left edge; distinct from paragraph formatting.

review.note: A vertical guide at the left with two selected panels flush against it, at the gap target. Object alignment, not text: the panels and axis separate it from Menu.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Align right
icons.meaning: Align selected objects to their right edge; distinct from paragraph formatting.

review.note: Align left reflected exactly: the guide and the panels' shared edge are on the right.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Box
icons.meaning: A package or inventory box.

review.note: A package seen from above a corner: a round-cornered hexagon with three faces meeting at the centre. The filled spine stops short of the lower corner, to keep the shared outer bound.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Check circle
icons.meaning: Confirmed or successful status in an enclosing circle.

review.note: Check inside the circular frame, clear of it by the gap target. Status needs its text as well.
review.usage: Pair with text that states the status; shape and color do not carry it alone. 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Circle
icons.meaning: A circular shape; do not imply control behavior.

review.note: A circle on the padding keyline. Ring in outline, disc in filled. It implies no control behavior.
review.usage: A plain shape, not a control. Do not imply behavior; name any action on the enclosing control.

icons.label: Ban
icons.meaning: Prohibited or unavailable action.

review.note: A heavier ring and bar in filled rather than a solid disc: the two counters are the prohibition sign, so they stay open.
review.usage: Pair with text that states the status; shape and color do not carry it alone. 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Close circle
icons.meaning: Dismissed or failed status in an enclosing circle.

review.note: Close inside the circular frame, clear of it by the gap target. Status needs its text as well.
review.usage: Pair with text that states the status; shape and color do not carry it alone. 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Cursor
icons.meaning: A pointer or selection tool.

review.note: A pointer: one acute round tip at the upper left and a notch opposite. A filled body, not a filled-in outline.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Dot
icons.meaning: A small solid dot, optically distinct from the full-size Circle.

review.note: Solid in both styles and well inside the keyline, so it cannot read as Circle. Filled is larger.
review.usage: A plain shape, not a control. Do not imply behavior; name any action on the enclosing control.

icons.label: Chevrons left
icons.meaning: Jump left or to the first item, with an enclosing action label.

review.note: Chevrons right reflected exactly.
review.usage: The application chooses left/right; artwork does not auto-mirror.

icons.label: Chevrons right
icons.meaning: Jump right or to the last item, with an enclosing action label.

review.note: Two chevrons, spaced so that the heavier pair still clears the gap target.
review.usage: The application chooses left/right; artwork does not auto-mirror.

icons.label: Bold
icons.meaning: Bold text formatting; authored letter B, no font outline reuse.

review.note: An authored B: two bowls on one stem, with no font outline. The heavier stroke keeps both counters open.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Type
icons.meaning: Typography or text-size controls; authored letter T.

review.note: An authored T, with no font outline. Serifs and a foot at 16 and 24 px keep it a letter; the 12 px master is the plain two strokes. The 12 outline stem sits on a pixel column, a registered 0.5 px offset.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Group
icons.meaning: Group or arrange selected objects, matching the current selection-group meaning.

review.note: Selection handles around two small objects: an arrange command, never people. Filled handles are registered below the action width at 12 and 16 px, to keep the objects clear.
review.usage: Visible label required at 12 px; contextual label recommended at other sizes.

icons.label: Heart
icons.meaning: Like or favorite with context; distinct from Star.

review.note: Two lobes running into one round point, with a soft notch. Distinct from Star's five points.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Input
icons.meaning: A text input field with an insertion cursor.

review.note: A wide field with a caret at its start. No prompt chevron, so it cannot read as Terminal.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Laptop
icons.meaning: A laptop device or desktop-sized preview.

review.note: A rounded screen over a wider capsule base, floating at the gap target.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Wand
icons.meaning: An assisted or automatic action, with an action label.

review.note: A capsule stick and a sparkle. The sparkle is a crossed capsule in outline and a four-point star in filled. A second accent at 24 px only.
review.usage: Keep a visible action label: the wand does not say what the automatic action does.

icons.label: Smartphone
icons.meaning: A mobile phone device or narrow preview.

review.note: A portrait rounded frame with a capsule home indicator, which separates it from an empty frame.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Moon
icons.meaning: Dark appearance or night; not a generic status.

review.note: A crescent cut by one circle, with rounded tips. Not a generic status.
review.usage: Name the appearance on the enclosing control; this is not a generic status.

icons.label: Square
icons.meaning: A square shape; do not imply control behavior.

review.note: A rounded square, CORNER_TOKEN on all four corners. It implies no control behavior.
review.usage: A plain shape, not a control. Do not imply behavior; name any action on the enclosing control.

icons.label: Layers
icons.meaning: A stack of layers or related objects.

review.note: One sheet in plan with the edge of another beneath. A second edge at 24 px only.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Sun
icons.meaning: Light appearance or daylight.

review.note: A round core and eight detached rays. Rays and bounds are shared; only the core fills.
review.usage: Name the appearance on the enclosing control; this is not a generic status.

icons.label: Table
icons.meaning: Tabular data with a header and cells.

review.note: A rounded frame with a header band and cells. The header stays solid in filled. Two cells at 12 px, four at 16 and 24 px.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Loader
icons.meaning: An in-progress segmented ring; animation belongs to the caller.

review.note: Eight capsule segments in a ring, with no centre, unlike Sun. Filled segments are registered below the action width at 12 and 16 px, to keep the gap target. Animation belongs to the caller.
review.usage: Announce progress in text; the caller owns motion and reduced-motion behavior.

icons.label: Code
icons.meaning: Source code brackets, distinct from the Terminal prompt.

review.note: Two angle brackets and a slash, with no frame or cursor, unlike Terminal. Filled strokes are registered below the action width at 12 and 16 px, where three parts must fit.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Dashboard
icons.meaning: An overview of multiple panels, distinct from a uniform Grid.

review.note: Four panels of unequal height on the Grid gutter: an overview, distinct from a uniform Grid.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.
